observations: Both brake assemblies contain separate upper/lower forward fittings and the catalogue lining-fastener counts. Pins, levers, adjustment and external anchor/stop fittings remain absent.
Forward detail exposes the two fork cheeks, steel heads and copper/brass lining hardware. Profile and fork width remain estimates.

Fixed HB133 overlay gives upper-pin residual (+0.440945,-0.461942) pixels and lower (-4.559055,+2.083333). The rear anchor residual remains (+9.164666,+2.503397). These points are diagnostic against an illustration with local depth conventions, not independent calibrated metrology.
The printed lining radius supplies the overlay scale, so that comparison cannot validate its own radius. No camera fit or source warp was introduced.

Case section exposes the formed copper tail and continuous clearance recess in the estimated rear bridge. Cuts affect display only. SNL22 does not establish this unseen casting profile or its strength.

SNL continuous MX109/M364 lining variant remains distinct from the handbook six-M364 arrangement. Source-sized lining ends and incomplete mechanism still need comparison when controls and supports are populated.
disposition: Reviewed local reconstruction approximation; no historical profile, complete mechanism or full installation claim.
open_issues: Forward fitting shape, fork width, pin bores and fastener head forms are estimates.
Source rivet stock-length datum remains uncertain; formed tails conserve the selected under-head stock model.
Brass screw threads represented by nominal shank and receiving bore, without helices.
M356 pins/cotters, lever members, adjustment, anchor supports and stops remain to populate.
M263 rear bridge clearance is an interface-driven estimate; casting shape and strength are not recovered from the source.
